# Review - PR 213 @ 5865b019824b6033d3b152ca24c8053382916726

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: e0dd73c1e082ceb775cba4c8ab5100c39a862d57. Small main-relative change (7 files, +56/-54): two proof bodies replaced by reuse of existing public tensor-sum and quadratic-form lemmas, five docstring and one section-heading rewording, one clarifying blueprint sentence, one audit paragraph and one telemetry record; no Lean statement, definition, hypothesis or error term is altered.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Base is `main`; merge base `5abb1eab02a9a5d6a83f69fe2b1556db7b335c22`. The worktree HEAD equals the published head `5865b019`, and I reviewed that sha.

Statement integrity. I read every hunk of the main-relative diff in full. No `theorem`/`def` signature changes: in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/LineMeasurement/Expanded.lean` only the proof of the private `heteroKron_sum_sum` changes, in `.../Projector.lean` only the proof of `sum_stateQForm_eprState_tauLineProj_one`, and in `.../SquareRootError.lean` and `.../LinePointOverlap.lean` only documentation. No hypothesis is added, no conclusion weakened, no bridge/residual/package input introduced, so the faithfulness policy (`AGENTS.md`, Faithful Formalization Policy) and anti-patterns A1-A6 are not engaged by this change.

Reuse over duplication. The two rewritten proofs now call `DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left`, `heteroKron_finset_sum_right` and `stateQForm_finset_sum` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems/Support.lean:253,263,273`) and `stateQForm_one_eq_norm_sq` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedPlacement.lean:119`), all of which exist at this head and none of which is introduced by this PR. This is a strict reduction of hand-rolled `Matrix.kroneckerMap` unfolding, in the direction CONTRIBUTING section 5 item 7 asks for. The remaining hand-proved private twin `heteroKron_sum_sum` in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedDefs.lean:296` is pre-existing, private, and its consolidation is recorded in the audit paragraph and tracked by the open organizational issue 204; it is not a defect of this diff.

Documentation and locators. `lineTauMeas` (`Expanded.lean:164-167`) now cites `def:line-tau-product-measurement`, which exists at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1692`, and paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-558`; lines 552-556 are exactly the display defining the summand `M^{(Line,W),l}_{f'} ⊗ τ^{W,l}_{f''}` and the description of τ, so the new locator is correct and strictly better than the replaced `527-532` (which points at the lemma statement, and which the neighbouring postprocessing lemma at `Expanded.lean:201-204` still cites correctly for item 1). The `SquareRootError.lean` docstrings now state the actual hypotheses (`∑ a, (A a)ᴴ * A a ≤ 1`) instead of the informal "square-summable", and keep the "formalization-only auxiliary" marking required by CONTRIBUTING section 5 item 9 for `sum_norm_sub_apply_sq_le_four`. The removed paragraphs only carried relocation history, whose removal CONTRIBUTING section 5 item 3 asks for, and the migration is recorded in `audits/2026-09-07-expanded-line-recovery.md` as that item requires.

Prose. The blueprint edit at `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1819-1820` adds "applied to the addition postprocessing of Definition~\ref{def:line-tau-product-measurement}" to the data-processing step of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`. This matches the paper argument (`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:558`) and the Lean route: `lineMeasExp_effect_eq_lineTauMeas_postprocess` (`Expanded.lean:205-213`) proves that the expanded line effect is the image of `lineTauMeas` under `(f',f'') ↦ f'+f''`. The reference does not need a new `\uses` entry because `lem:expanded-line-measurement-postprocess`, already listed at line 1803, carries `\uses{def:expanded-line-measurement, def:line-tau-product-measurement}`. No `\lean`/`\leanok` tag is added or changed by this diff, so no status claim is newly made. The audit paragraph is accurate against the files it names. I found no Lean jargon, no banned software-engineering vocabulary and no unsupported proof claim in the added prose.

Verification. `grep -nE "sorry|admit|^axiom |native_decide"` over the four changed Lean files returns nothing. `lake env lean` on `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/LineMeasurement/Expanded.lean` and on `.../Projector.lean` in the PR worktree completes with no diagnostics. Exact-head CI at `5865b019` is green: `local-ci/summary` "all gating steps passed (296s)", with build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, paper-gaps, file-length, proof-debt and proof-evasion all success and statement-origin skipped by path filter.

Prior reviews. The three earlier marked reviews are at heads `ebba143d`, `a4c4f8e7` and `e127e8b7`; the most recent one is APPROVED with an empty findings block, so no prior finding is left unresolved at this head, and the items it listed as addressed (tensor-sum reuse, projector normalization reuse, a blueprint definition for `lineTauMeas`, documented normalization for the bound of four, removal of relocation history, completed-measurement terminology) are all still in place at `5865b019`.

Not checked. I did not run a full `lake build` or the blueprint HTML build (both are covered by the green exact-head CI and the machine-wide build lock forbids me starting one), did not re-verify declarations outside the main-relative diff, and did not re-audit axiom closures of untouched declarations.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
